chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Jamīl, from more than one of our companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Cutting off the head of the dead is more severe than cutting off the head of the living."
ai.seo_question: How serious is cutting or mutilating the body of a dead person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the grave seriousness of mutilating the body of a deceased person. It indicates the sanctity and inviolability of the dead body in Islamic legal and moral teaching.
